## Summary

Brief description of the schema, content or tooling change.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Schema update
- [ ] Content addition/modification
- [ ] Validation/governance rule
- [ ] Tooling or CI
- [ ] Documentation

> Routine clinical content editing should go through CDM, not this repo. Direct
> content edits here are for repository maintenance, tooling or schema changes,
> recovery, or exceptional administrative work — say which this is.

## Cross-Repo Coordination

**If this touches schema:**

- [ ] CDM updated for the new field
  - [ ] Its type carries the field
  - [ ] Its validator rejects what `tool/validate_content.py` rejects, so an
        authoring error surfaces in CDM rather than here after publication
  - [ ] Opening and saving a published item in CDM does not drop the field

- [ ] App parsers updated for the new field
  - [ ] `fromJson` handles it, including when an older pack omits it
  - [ ] Test fixtures include the new structure
  - [ ] Parity cases pass, and `test/cda_contract_test.dart` passes — it runs
        the app's own engines over this repository

- [ ] `minimumAppVersion` gated in `tool/sync_manifest.py` when content using
      the field would be mis-read by an older build
  - [ ] If the pack floor moves, the PR says so: installs below the new floor
        stop receiving content until they upgrade

- [ ] All 3 repo CHANGELOGs updated with coordination note?

**Example coordination note:**
```
### Cross-Repo Impact (v0.X.0)
- **CDA**: Added `newField` to scoring-tool-schema.json; gated to app 0.X.0
- **CDM**: Type and validation updated so authoring errors surface in CDM
- **App**: RemoteScoringEvaluation.fromJson handles new field
- **Tested**: Parity cases pass with latest CDM output
```

## Testing

CI runs this sequence read-only and fails if validation leaves a working-tree
diff. Run it locally first (`.venv/bin/python`, or `.venv/Scripts/python.exe` on
Windows):

- [ ] `tool/validate_content.py`
- [ ] `tool/validate_references.py` and `tool/validate_references.py --strict`
- [ ] `tool/validate_remote_engines.py`
- [ ] `tool/generate_reference_usage.py`
- [ ] `tool/sync_manifest.py --write` then `tool/validate_manifest_safety.py`
      then `tool/sync_manifest.py --check`
- [ ] `tool/validate_content.py --base-ref origin/main` — CI runs this on a
      branch, so every changed content item must have its version field
      incremented

## Checklist

- [ ] Schema is valid JSON, and `$id` points at this repo's `main`
- [ ] All required fields documented
- [ ] Parity cases defined (scoring/blood tools), and a new rule has a case that
      actually fails without it — a case that passes either way covers nothing
- [ ] `manifest.json` regenerated by `sync_manifest.py --write`, never by hand
      (any schema or content change rewrites its hashes)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (with coordination details)
